changes: src/appearance/website-theme.js: samples the elements painted at each point and looks through raised see-through layers that cover the window; the page background counts as three of five points; after loading, page-spanning wrappers near the top of the page are rechecked at most every 500 ms.

scripts/community-list-tools.ps1: an unsupported site (such as name.*) is dropped from a cosmetic rule's site list instead of skipping the whole rule; the rule is still skipped when no included site is left or an excluded site is unsupported.
rules/community-cosmetic.json and rules/community-info.json rebuilt; every other generated rule file is byte-identical.

ruleTests.result: PASS: 30 cosmetic compilation assertions (21 before; 9 new)
PASS: CyberAssist catalog matches all 247 reviewed domains; PASS: 237 offline rule/import assertions

regressionProof.websiteThemeUnit: Against the original website-theme.js the three new tests fail: a light page behind a cookie notice stayed 'off', a light page with a dark banner stayed 'off', and no paced check followed a change below <body>. The eight existing tests pass on both versions.
regressionProof.cosmeticConverter: Against the original converter the extended cosmetic test fails: the procedural rule listed beside a wild.* site was dropped (4 procedural rules instead of 5).

communityBundle.examples: ##.ad now applies on cnn.com, nytimes.com and foxnews.com, which the skipped rule also listed with tripadvisor.*

probes.note: Offline loopback probe pages from the review, run with a scratch harness against the original and the fixed script. The reproducible coverage is the four new checks in tests/website-theme-browser.cjs.

limits: name.* wildcard sites themselves are still unsupported: 249 rules for such sites only are skipped.
Dimming layers other than <dialog> backdrops still render as a grey veil (127-150 on a 12-13 page) under the filter.
A see-through layer without a positive z-index counts as the page's own background.
After loading, only theme attribute changes on <html>, <body> or a page-spanning element up to five levels below <body> are noticed.
A first screen that is dark at all five points makes a page count as dark even when it is light further down.
harness: Unit, rule and browser suites ran from a copy of commit 00fb398 plus only this change's files, so edits by other sessions in the shared checkout could not reach the tested package. Browser runs used disposable profiles, owned loopback pages and the deny proxy.
attempts: The first focused Firefox website-theme run stopped at browser startup (session.new timed out) before any check; the retry passed.
A full-suite run on an earlier copy was stopped after a final change to website-theme.js (rechecks limited to elements within five levels of <body>) and restarted on the final files.

A rules.test.ps1 run in the shared working tree failed "offline rebuild is deterministic": another session changed lists/reported-threats.json and scripts/threat-report-tools.ps1 between the test's two builds (threat expiry 2026-11-30 in the first, 2027-02-28 in the second). The same suite passed on the frozen copy.
